ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum-classical application that solves portfolio optimization problems using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver via IBM Qiskit.
ideas.title: Qiskit VQE Portfolio Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages IBM's primary ecosystem framework (Qiskit) which aligns well with evaluation preferences in a partnered Qiskit Fall Fest event.

ideas.pitch: An educational web interface that visually breaks down how Qiskit transpiles high-level quantum gates into native hardware instructions for specific IBM Quantum backends.
ideas.title: Quantum Circuit Transpiler Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges at IBM-partnered hackathons heavily reward tooling that improves developer experience and demystifies quantum hardware constraints.

ideas.pitch: A practical simulation of the E91 quantum key distribution protocol using Bell states to detect eavesdropping on simulated noisy quantum channels.
ideas.title: Entanglement-Based Quantum Key Distribution Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements a sophisticated cryptographic protocol that demonstrates practical understanding of quantum mechanics beyond basic tutorials.

ideas.pitch: An interactive dashboard simulating the 3-qubit bit flip code and phase flip code to show real-time syndrome measurement and error correction.
ideas.title: Quantum Error Correction Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles one of the most pressing engineering hurdles in quantum computing with a clean, demonstrable live user interface.

ideas.pitch: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network using parametrized quantum circuits as a feature map for classifying small-scale image datasets.
ideas.title: Quantum Machine Learning Image Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines two high-interest domains—machine learning and quantum computing—showcasing advanced implementation skills within a tight hackathon window.
